name: PhotoModel sources
description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Photo's window: PhotoWorkspace (the open image's size and name, the layer stack with each layer's offset and its pixels as copy-on-write CoreRaster tiles (TiledPixels), so an edit copies only the tiles it touches, the selected layer, tool, and the brush's and eraser's own tool options with the brush cursor diameter, the marquee selection and pending crop), the tools' drags (brush and eraser dabs, marquee, crop, move, and the Clone and Heal tools' Option-click to sample and drag to clone or heal), the clone stamp (a sampled source and a stroke that copies from it at a fixed offset onto the selected layer, and heal, the same stroke with each dab shifted to the tone where it lands), selection edits and crop, Image Size, Rotate and Straighten (worked out off the main actor, committed unless the image changed), the undo history (the tiles an edit changed, layer lists and whole stacks, read as a list of named steps from "New Image" or "Open" with a jump to any step), the tile-parallel renderer with damage tracking (a full frame as the reference, or the live canvas's update: only the damaged tiles, premultiplied) and the adjustments it applies (exposure, levels, curves, hue/saturation, blur) with the curve editor's samples and histogram, opening and exporting through the PhotoImageCodec protocol, the adjustment settings and logarithmic gamma track (with the Gamma field's commit, a no-op for the value it shows), what the inspector shows (with the panel header lines and the viewer status size text), and when each Layer menu item can run (with Bring Forward and Send Backward, one place up or down the stack, and Select Layer Above and Below).
